_doc: Rogueloot affixes. prefixes = power (damage, armour, health, speed); suffixes = utility (attributes, resists, regen, finds). An item holds at most 3 prefixes and 3 suffixes, and only ONE affix per `group` (so an item cannot roll two different flat elemental damages, but can roll +fire% AND +fire flat since those are different groups). UNITS: `units: "flat"` is a plain number added to the stat. `units: "pct"` is WHOLE PERCENTAGE POINTS: 12 means +12%. There are NO fractions anywhere in this file. The sheet converts once, in one function (pct -> x/100). Past games shipped two readers disagreeing on 0.02 vs 2 — do not add a third. TIERS count UP with power: tier 1 is the weakest and is open from item level 1; `ilvlMin` says the lowest ITEM LEVEL (not character level) that can roll that tier. The ladder is [1,8,15,23,32,42,52,62] which puts tiers 1-3 in Act 1 Normal (ilvl <= 22), 4-5 in Veteran / Act 2, 6-7 in Legend / Act 3, and tier 8 only at the very top (ilvl 62+, boss drops in Legend at area level 60). `min`/`max` is the roll range inside the tier. TIER PICK: eligible tiers are those with ilvlMin <= ilvl. Each eligible tier's pick weight = `weight` * fade, where fade = 1 when (ilvl - ilvlMin) <= 10, else max(0.2, 1 - (ilvl - ilvlMin - 10) / 30). Base weights fall with the tier ([100,80,62,48,36,26,17,10]) so the newest tier is never the most likely one, but old tiers fade so an ilvl-40 item is not full of tier-1 rolls. Worked example at ilvl 20: tier 1 (gap 19) 100*0.7 = 70, tier 2 (gap 12) 80*0.93 = 74.7, tier 3 (gap 5) 62*1 = 62 -> 34% / 36% / 30%. AFFIX PICK: among affixes whose `kinds` include the item's kind (weapons use their kind id, armour uses the slot, shield/focus/quiver use that word, rings "ring", amulets "neck") and whose `proficiency` list (if any) includes the base's proficiency, excluding groups already on the item, pick uniformly by affix (then a tier by the rule above). Prefix or suffix is chosen first: an item with room on both sides picks prefix 50/50. COUNT per rarity (rarity.json `affixCount` holds the same numbers): magic 1-2 (one prefix and/or one suffix, 60% one, 40% two), rare 3-6 where the share of 5s and 6s grows with ilvl, legendary = 3-5 affixes rolled like a rare PLUS one legendary power (legendaries.json), unique = fixed (uniques.json). LEVEL REQUIREMENT of a finished item: max(base.levelReq, ceil(0.8 * highest ilvlMin among its affix tiers)). A tier-3 roll (ilvlMin 15) on a level-1 ring makes it a level-12 ring. DAMAGE ORDER on a weapon hit: (base min..max + physDamageFlat [x1.5 on two-handers] + attackPower/14) * (1 + physDamagePct/100) -> plus each elemental flat * (1 + thatElementPct/100) -> crit -> target armour / resist. SMART ROLL (personal loot only): when the roll is for a specific player, affixes useless to their Path are given weight 0.25 instead of being removed (mana on a Fighter, attack speed on a Mage): drops stay surprising, mostly useful.

rare._doc: weights for 3/4/5/6 affixes by ilvl band (whole percent)

legendary._doc: affixes rolled like a rare, then capped at 5 (the power takes a slot), plus one power

prefixes.name: Honed
prefixes.desc: +X physical damage per hit (added to min and max). The two-handed bonus: a 2h weapon multiplies this by 1.5 (code: kinds[kind].hands === 2).

prefixes.name: Brutal
prefixes.desc: +X% physical weapon damage (applied after flat added damage).

prefixes.name: Searing
prefixes.desc: +X fire damage per hit. One elemental flat affix per weapon (group elemFlat).

prefixes.name: Rimed
prefixes.desc: +X frost damage per hit; frost hits slow 15% for 2 s.

prefixes.name: Crackling
prefixes.desc: +X storm damage per hit (wide range, low floor: storm is swingy).

prefixes.name: Venomed
prefixes.desc: +X poison damage over 4 seconds per hit (total, dealt in 1 s ticks, stacks refresh).

prefixes.name: Duskbitten
prefixes.desc: +X shadow damage per hit.

prefixes.name: Vicious
prefixes.desc: +X attack power (14 attack power = +1 weapon damage per hit; the sheet does that once).

prefixes.name: Attuned
prefixes.desc: +X spell power (added to the spell's base damage/heal before % modifiers).

prefixes.name: Blazing
prefixes.desc: +X% fire damage (spells and weapon fire). One elemental % affix per item (group elemPct).

prefixes.name: Glacial
prefixes.desc: +X% frost damage.

prefixes.name: Thundering
prefixes.desc: +X% storm damage.

prefixes.name: Festering
prefixes.desc: +X% poison damage.

prefixes.name: Gloaming
prefixes.desc: +X% shadow damage.

prefixes.name: Mending
prefixes.desc: +X% healing done.

prefixes.name: Keen
prefixes.desc: +X% critical strike chance (additive to the sheet; base crit 5%, soft cap 50%).

prefixes.name: Quick
prefixes.desc: +X% attack speed (multiplies attacks per second; cap +60% total).

prefixes.name: Fluent
prefixes.desc: +X% cast speed (shortens cast bars; does not shorten the 1.5 s global cooldown below 1.0 s).

prefixes.name: Sturdy
prefixes.desc: +X armour (flat, added before armourPct).

prefixes.name: Reinforced
prefixes.desc: +X% armour of this item (the base armour plus its flat affix).

prefixes.name: Stout
prefixes.desc: +X maximum health. (Level-1 health is ~100; +10 is a tenth of a life.)

prefixes.name: Clear
prefixes.desc: +X maximum mana (Mage/Healer resource). On a rage/energy character this affix is still legal but useless — the rarity roller skips it when the dropper is a personal-loot roll for a non-mana player (rarity.json `smartLoot`).

prefixes.name: Bracing
prefixes.desc: +X% block chance (additive with the shield's own; cap 75%).

prefixes.name: Bulwark
prefixes.desc: +X% block amount of this shield.

suffixes.name: of Strength
suffixes.desc: +X Strength (each point: +1 attack power with str weapons, +0.5 armour).

suffixes.name: of Agility
suffixes.desc: +X Agility (+1 attack power with agi weapons, +0.05% dodge, +0.04% crit).

suffixes.name: of Intellect
suffixes.desc: +X Intellect (+1 spell power, +5 mana).

suffixes.name: of Vitality
suffixes.desc: +X Vitality (+8 health each).

suffixes.name: of Spirit
suffixes.desc: +X Spirit (+0.5 healing power, +0.3 mana regen per 5 s, +0.1 health regen per 5 s).

suffixes.name: of Cinders
suffixes.desc: +X% fire resistance (cap 75%, ruling 41).

suffixes.name: of Rime
suffixes.desc: +X% frost resistance.

suffixes.name: of the Gale
suffixes.desc: +X% storm resistance.

suffixes.name: of the Adder
suffixes.desc: +X% poison resistance.

suffixes.name: of Lanterns
suffixes.desc: +X% shadow resistance.

suffixes.name: of Warding
suffixes.desc: +X% to all five resistances (its own group, so it stacks with one single resist of each element).

suffixes.name: of the Oak
suffixes.desc: +X health per 5 seconds (always on; natural regen is slow per ruling 23 so this is a real stat).

suffixes.name: of the Spring
suffixes.desc: +X mana per 5 seconds.

suffixes.name: of the Leech
suffixes.desc: +X health per weapon hit (melee and ranged auto-attacks and weapon skills, not spells).

suffixes.name: of the Well
suffixes.desc: +X mana when you kill an enemy.

suffixes.name: of the Fox
suffixes.desc: +X% dodge (cloth and leather only: the roller skips it on mail/plate; cap 40%).

suffixes.name: of the Hare
suffixes.desc: +X% movement speed (feet only; cap +40%).

suffixes.name: of Precision
suffixes.desc: +X% chance to hit (counters the level-gap miss chance of ruling 41).

suffixes.name: of Ruin
suffixes.desc: +X% critical strike damage (base crit = 150%).

suffixes.name: of the Purse
suffixes.desc: +X% gold dropped (your own drops only).

suffixes.name: of Fortune
suffixes.desc: +X% better rarity (see rarity.json `magicFind`: diminishing, never changes drop COUNT).

suffixes.name: of Thorns
suffixes.desc: Melee attackers take X physical damage per hit on you.

suffixes.name: of Ease
suffixes.desc: -X% attribute requirements of this item (not the level requirement).

suffixes.name: of Haste
suffixes.desc: -X% skill cooldowns (not the global cooldown; cap 40%). Starts at ilvl 8: no tier 1.

suffixes.name: of Draughts
suffixes.desc: +X% potion healing / mana restored (belt only).

suffixes.name: of Menace
suffixes.desc: +X% threat generated (tanks). Mail/plate/shield only.

suffixes.name: of Quiet
suffixes.desc: -X% threat generated. Cloth/leather only (same group as of Menace).

suffixes.name: of Staggering
suffixes.desc: X% chance per weapon hit to stagger (0.6 s stun; bosses: 0.3 s and only every 8 s).

suffixes.name: of the Watch
suffixes.desc: +X metres of light radius in dark dungeons (a comfort stat; cheap, common).
